senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) work, trade, vocation; task.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:10">Ab. I, 10</cite> <he>אהוב את המ׳</he> love trade, opp. to <cite ref="T00124"><he>רבנות</he></cite>, office.

<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:8">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>אני מְלַאכְתִּי בעיר</he> my work (study) is done in town, <he>והוא מְלַאכְתּוֹ בשדה וכ׳</he> and his, in the field &c., v. <cite ref="C00244"><he>גָּדַר</he></cite>.
Ab. II, 14 בעל מְלַאכְתְּךָ thy employer (the Lord).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:15">Ib. 15</cite> <he>היום קצר והמ׳ מרובה</he> the day (life) is short, and the task great.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 11:1">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XI</cite> <he>ועשו בו מ׳ בשבת</he> (not <he>ועשה</he>) and they made him work on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:1">Sabb. VII, 1</cite> <he>אב מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00017"><he>אָב</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M01473"><he>מְלָאכוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>עשה מ׳ הרבה וכ׳</he> he did several (forbidden) labors on several successive Sabbaths. Ib. 2, v. <cite ref="A00017"><he>אָב</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
